title: Required proof dimensions and their method-specific gates
scopeNotes: A smaller numerical endpoint does not imply every analytic dimension improved.
Capacity slope, intercept, admissible domain and source eligibility must be compared together.
An inherited theorem used by a new consumer is distinct from a new analytic estimate.
Verification is categorical evidence, not a numerical strength score.
The radar footprint marks where a method changes the proof; its area is not a mathematical quality metric.
No single universal LOW/HIGH or moment formula is asserted for incomparable methods.
Admission status can change after this snapshot; the live catalogue and exact-head certificate are authoritative.

nodes.label: Inverse moment
nodes.description: Controls marked Möbius polynomials and the long inverse witness.

formulas.plain: Marked inverse second moment with two simultaneous capacity gates.
formulas.domain: Fixed positive c1,c2; bounded row-independent prime coefficients; either common character orientation; every subcollection.
formulas.context: Lengths are normalized to row width one. Full-width form replaces 1,3 by M,3M.
formulas.scope: Natural nonunit zeros, common profiles and polynomial height costs must remain; no prime mesh is needed for this contract.

formulas.domain: 0≤r≤2 in the recorded Cycle61 input; sixth-power-free rows; fixed smooth profiles.
formulas.context: Sixth-power amplification gives the long detector line.
formulas.scope: This is an unmarked moment exponent, not a zero-free endpoint.

requiredChecks: Both marked capacity inequalities
Original zero extensions
Common profiles and independent height costs
Sixth-power rows or their explicit reconstruction

nodes.label: Paired plain + prime capacity
nodes.description: Controls the squared product of two physical plain polynomials and selected prime slots.

formulas.tex: n_1+n_2+6\kappa z\le M\ \Longrightarrow\ \sum_{u\ {\rm eligible}}|S_{u,1}S_{u,2}Q_{u,I}|^2\ll Z^{M+\varepsilon}\mathcal H_J
formulas.plain: Paired plain moment with prime-slot cost 6κ.
formulas.domain: Cycle25: 7/10≤κ≤3/4, β*≥51/100, 2β*−1≤κ for positive slots. M includes row plus moving-character width.
formulas.context: Symmetric form: 2m+6κz≤M. The zero-slot assertion has a separate unrestricted bounded-length contract.
formulas.scope: Only the actual canonical prime pools, common profile, literal natural eligibility, masks and choice order are licensed. Arbitrary coefficient families are not interchangeable.

formulas.plain: Strictly interior affine capacity with both slope and intercept.
formulas.domain: Width M=1; .41≤n1,n2≤.44; .034≤z≤.04; fixed parent of moving width zero.
formulas.context: Cycle61 Theorem 2.2; includes the four derivative-profile pairs needed by physical scale recovery.
formulas.scope: Λ alone does not measure strength: B<1 and the local length box are essential. This is not a global replacement for the old capacity plane.

requiredChecks: Full capacity plane including its intercept
Admissible length box and moving width
Literal prime pools and row eligibility
Independent heights, profiles and four derivative pairs
Every shortened child uses a licensed estimate

nodes.label: Prime amplitudes + selection
nodes.description: Carries actual prime-slot amplitudes into detector and numerator consumers.

formulas.tex: 0\le g_i\le\delta/2,\quad q=L^{-1}\sum_i z_i g_i=\delta p,\quad0\le p\le1/2
formulas.plain: Amplitude classes and their weighted average.
formulas.domain: U=Z^d; local slot widths zi=ℓi/d; L=Σzi; δ=2a−1.
formulas.context: Classify the actual physical main slots; errors and small amplitudes carry gi=0.
formulas.scope: The family zero bound and original natural holes are retained. Slot amplitudes are not independent free coefficients.

formulas.plain: Whole-slot greedy selection at capacity z.
formulas.domain: 0≤z≤L; sufficiently fine mesh selected in the prescribed order.
formulas.context: One fractional slot is discarded, with its explicit mesh loss.
formulas.scope: Any separate inverse/plain slot selections or overlapping pools require their own collision/allocation proof.

requiredChecks: Pointwise amplitude ceiling
Whole-slot supply at each consumer
Greedy overshoot or mesh loss
Overlapping-pool collision partitions when present
Original relative characters and masks

nodes.label: Shared-zero witness + row count
nodes.description: Combines inverse/plain witnesses for the same selected zero before feeding the population exponent into HIGH.

formulas.domain: r+m≥t up to paid tolerances; selected capacities (1−r)/2 and (1−2m)/(6κ) must be supplied.
formulas.context: The witness uses one actual zero, a common frequency and genuine common-profile polynomials.
formulas.scope: Two independent moment bounds do not by themselves prove an improved joint covariance estimate.

formulas.domain: 0≤p≤1/2; 0≤δ≤5/6 with endpoint interpretation; used κ and prime supply must satisfy the source gates.
formulas.context: Number of rows ≪ U^(Rκ+ε) times a fixed polynomial in height.
formulas.scope: Row density must be proved for the actual dictionary and its modulus bounds, including restored sixth-power multiples.

formulas.plain: PR56 applies the existing Cycle61 affine moment to the detector.
formulas.context: New application/consumer of Cycle61 Theorem 2.2, previously used for the physical source row.
formulas.scope: The PR describes per-character moment degrees and heights; official acceptance is separate from this proposed formula.

requiredChecks: Same-zero and common-frequency witness
Actual finite dictionary and conductor bounds
Floor bins handled separately
Full continuous density/amplitude domain
Height choice after returned analytic degree

nodes.label: LOW reflected energy
nodes.description: Bounds the complete compensated physical probe directly using completed theta reflection and marked energy.

formulas.plain: Nonpositive correction for every marked/rescaled subset in the recorded LOW geometry.
formulas.domain: The source must first satisfy the retained completed-index energy gates and physical scale relations.
formulas.context: Controls all compensated subsets, not merely the unmarked principal term.
formulas.scope: This scalar correction is not an independent proof of theta reflection or the complete LOW estimate.

formulas.plain: RH–GEX complete LOW exponent in its one-parameter geometry.
formulas.domain: b=1/8; lx=17/48−p/2; ly=23/48−p/2; h=13/16+3p/2; p=1/6000 in the verified instance.
formulas.scope: Specific to the stated geometry and completed source; do not apply this formula to arbitrary method parameters.

requiredChecks: Completed index cn³ with original coprimality rules
Both reflection collision masks and cusp terms
All marked/rescaled subsets
Physical normalization and all height costs

nodes.label: HIGH physical numerator
nodes.description: Bounds the complementary zero-sensitive source using the actual numerator, detector count and source-preserving weighted averages across required row ranges.

formulas.tex: \sum_{u\ {\rm in\ class}}|\mathcal N_u|\ll Y^{-1/2}Z^{\ell(z_0-1/2)+\ell q}U^{1/4+3R/4-qz_A/2+\varepsilon}\mathcal H_J
formulas.domain: Cycle25 form: m=log(Y)/log(U)>1/2; zA=[2min(m,1)−1]/(6κ)≤L; Re(s)=a plus source buffer; z0=.34.
formulas.context: Mellin inversion and reflection act on the complete reconstructed physical numerator before the reciprocal denominator is estimated.
formulas.scope: Euler correction terms, strict ramified errors and conductor deficits are part of the estimate. A generic arbitrary-coefficient fourth moment is not a substitute.

formulas.plain: Cycle61 affine capacity in the physical numerator.
formulas.domain: Only d near h and small Euler free shift t, with n and zA inside Theorem 2.2’s local box; remaining shifts use separate paid branches.
formulas.context: Hölder contributes −q zA/2 to the numerator exponent.
formulas.scope: The intercept deficit 1−B, both plain factors, all shortenings and the original slot gain must remain.

requiredChecks: Actual signed physical coefficient before absolute values
Conductor deficit for every Euler error subset
All ramified terms and all free shifts
Common profile scale recovery
Population exponent applied only to licensed rows

nodes.label: Principal + floor + intermediate
nodes.description: Pays branches that do not disappear when LOW or HIGH improves.
nodes.formulaStatus: Method-specific gates; no universal scalar formula is asserted.
requiredChecks: Nonzero positive principal residue
Convergent Euler products on required contours
Principal poles and zero frequencies
Small-row floor estimates
Intermediate row ranges and every branch junction
Normalizer, dyadic, contour and tail losses

nodes.label: Geometry + endpoint
nodes.description: Chooses physical scales so every source branch is below the same signal exponent.

formulas.plain: Saturated compensated-probe geometry and signal exponent.
formulas.domain: Recorded Part-II parameterizations satisfying their additional positivity, energy, row extension and source supply gates.
formulas.context: x,y are physical plain lengths; ℓ is total slot length; h is the largest row exponent.
formulas.scope: These identities alone do not establish any endpoint; LOW/HIGH/principal gates are separately required.

formulas.plain: LOW/signal crossing in the recorded optimized construction.
formulas.domain: Only where the complete LOW estimate and saturated geometry establish this crossing.
formulas.context: Increasing ℓ lowers θ but may violate HIGH, moment, principal or supply constraints.
formulas.scope: Not a universal formula for every QRH method or the alternate short-row recovery route.

formulas.domain: Unique root in the displayed interval; θ=11/12−ℓ/4≈.8748866470399641.
formulas.context: The catalogue rational is a proved upper enclosure, not the exact algebraic boundary.
formulas.scope: Tightening an enclosure does not improve the underlying theorem.

requiredChecks: Positive physical scales and common slot supply
Uniform LOW/HIGH comparison on the entire continuous domain
Exact branch coverage and endpoint certificates
Positive allowances for all reconstruction losses

nodes.label: Full recovery + verification
nodes.description: Turns compatible source estimates into the exact unconditional all-family zero-free theorem and verifies its meaning.
nodes.formulaStatus: Categorical proof and verification obligations; no numeric strength score.
requiredChecks: All original masks, Euler errors, cusp sources and residues
All dyads, independent heights and profile derivatives
Correct parameter and degree choice order
Mellin continuation and rightmost-zero contradiction
All Dirichlet moduli and imprimitive characters; principal pole exception
Exact canonical theorem definitions and literal endpoint
Comparator and permitted-axiom closure
Lean plus independent NanoDa and con-ron acceptance when claimed
Tracker admission and merge recorded separately from contributor checks
